text:
marco: FYI PR #4962 updates migration guide snippets (Python/TS), fixes two dead links, and renames request id -> request_identifier. Planning to merge tomorrow morning but want a quick style pass. Can @jin and @ally glance?

jin: I can do a snippet pass. Quick question: are we now using model_version everywhere instead of model?

marco: Yes — standardize on model_version in all snippets and add a one-line note about pinning for reproducibility.

ally: Tone note: switch step lists to imperative voice. Also avoid 'we recommend' and use short actionable phrasing.

jin: Small code nit: in Python examples use snake_case for payload keys (request_identifier) and import from redwood import RedwoodClient. Replace client.generate() with client.text_generate(...).

marco: Good catches. I updated the imports, replaced generate, and changed the payload keys. Added a brief retry example referencing RateLimitError.

docs-bot: PR #4962 9: preview deployed (staging). Status: linkcheck failed.

ally: If linkcheck is the only blocker, schedule a clean build in the morning and hold merge until preview is green and both approvals are present.

marco: Sounds good. I'll request review from @jin and @ally and hold merge per the checklist.
